title: Raw Validity Formula Cost Bound
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state Turing machine with $k$ work tapes, and let $n,s\in\mathbb{N}$. The validity CNF cost is at most $((n+2)+1+3(n+2)^2)+((|\mathrm{State}(M)|+1)+1+3(|\mathrm{State}(M)|+1)^2)+k((2s+1)+1+3(2s+1)^2)+3k(2s+1)+3$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite-state Turing machine $M$ with $k$ work tapes
